English (সম্পূর্ণ সিলেবাস)

1. Reading Comprehension.
2. Vocabulary (antonyms and synonyms; phrases and idioms; word formation through prefixation, suffixation, compounding; terminology related to education and administration).
3. Usage of Grammar (Voice; Narration; Preposition; Common Errors; Right Form of Verbs; Transformation of Sentences; Articles; Punctuation; Filling gaps with appropriate

style of writing; Writing paragraphs, essays, project proposals).
